text: The Dold-Kan correspondence gives an equivalence between:
choices: simplicial abelian groups and chain complexes of abelian groups (in non-negative degrees)
explanation: Dold-Kan: sAb ≃ Ch_{≥0}(Ab). Every simplicial abelian group corresponds to a connective chain complex. The normalisation functor N gives the equivalence; it is a key bridge between homological and simplicial algebra.
